scenes.title: Key ideas
items: A normal wallet (an EOA, externally owned account) is controlled by one private key
scenes.vo: First, A normal wallet (an EOA, externally owned account) is controlled by one private key. A smart account is a contract wallet whose rules you choose. Next, ERC-4337 (account abstraction): smart accounts without changing Ethereum itself. Transactions become "user operations" handled by bundlers; paymasters can pay gas for you (for example in U.S.D.C.). Then, Features: multisig and social recovery (trusted "guardians" can restore access), spending limits, session keys (Lesson 14.2), batching (approve + swap in one step), passkeys (log in with your device's biometrics instead of a seed phrase). Also, EIP-7702 (2025): lets an ordinary wallet temporarily or permanently delegate to smart-account code: powerful, and a phishing target (Lesson 1.7). And finally, New risks: the account's contract code, module/plugin permissions, guardian collusion, and differences between chains (the same address may not exist on every chain).

scenes.title: Worked example
steps: Your operating wallet becomes a smart account with
scenes.vo: Let's work an example, step by step. Your operating wallet becomes a smart account with: a passkey on your phone plus a hardware key (2-of-2 for large moves); a $2,000 a day limit for small moves with just the passkey; 3 guardians (2-of-3) who can recover access after a 48-hour delay you can cancel. Lose your phone: recover via guardians. Phone stolen: the thief is capped at $2,000 a day and you have 48 hours to cancel a recovery you didn't start.

scenes.title: Checklist
items: I know which of my wallets are EOAs and which are smart accounts
Guardians chosen so no two could plausibly collude; recovery has a cancel delay
Smart account deployed (or deployable) on every chain I send to
scenes.vo: Here's your checklist. Do it now, for real. First, I know which of my wallets are EOAs and which are smart accounts. Next, Guardians chosen so no two could plausibly collude; recovery has a cancel delay. Then, Module/plugin permissions reviewed like approvals. And finally, Smart account deployed (or deployable) on every chain I send to.
